svg.title: Bug classification accuracy. GraphCodeBERT 94.54 percent, CodeBERT 93.99 percent, DistilBERT 92.90 percent, all fine-tuned transformers. Naïve Bayes, the classical baseline, 74.59 percent. 1,552 hand-labelled reports across seven categories, agreement checked with Fleiss' Kappa.
